name: wubi_select_and_gates
note: 2026-10-11（#6789）起，混输关闭时组字开头的 `z` 打开临时拼音反查，所以 `z` 的拒绝改在五笔码中间检验：`wqb` 之后的 `z` 仍交回宿主，组字不变。

databases.msime-pinyin.db: CREATE TABLE wubi86(key TEXT,value TEXT,weight INTEGER);INSERT INTO wubi86 VALUES('w','人',20);INSERT INTO wubi86 VALUES('wq','你',10);INSERT INTO wubi86 VALUES('wqb','爷',20);INSERT INTO wubi86 VALUES('wqi','你',10);INSERT INTO wubi86 VALUES('wqbb','父子',30);
